summary: Brazil Potash Corp. filed a prospectus supplement on Form 424B5 for an underwritten public offering of 3,700,000 common shares at $2.50 per share, with pre-funded warrants to purchase up to 18,300,000 common shares at $2.499 per warrant (exercise price $0.001). Total expected gross proceeds are approximately $55 million. The offering is a routine capital raise, not a special situation. The securities are listed on NYSE American (symbol GRO). The transaction closed on May 4, 2026, with no special-situation elements such as a control change, activist campaign, restructuring, or going-private event.
